title: List session threads
summary: List a session's threads — the primary thread first, then children in creation order (archived included) — under the same cursor envelope as GET /v1/sessions/{id}/events.

response.name: data
response.description: Thread objects: id (sth_), parent_thread_id (null on the primary), agent_name, status, usage counters, timestamps, archived_at.

response.name: next_cursor
response.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when this is the last.

title: Retrieve a session thread
summary: Return one thread object with agent as the resolved definition snapshot; stats and usage are null until the thread first transitions.

response.name: thread
response.description: The thread object: id, parent_thread_id, agent_name, agent snapshot, status, stats/usage, timestamps, archived_at.

title: List thread events
summary: Read the thread's own event log with the same cursor envelope as the session-level events route. Events carry seq, type, content, metadata; rows shared with the primary stream keep the same row and seq.

response.name: data
response.description: Events on this thread's stream ordered by sequence.

response.name: next_cursor
response.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when this is the last.

title: Stream thread events (SSE)
summary: Server-sent events over the thread's own stream with the same Last-Event-ID resume cursor and event_deltas[] opt-in as the session-level stream — a filter over the same broadcast.

response.name: event stream
response.description: SessionEvent frames on this thread's stream; keepalives are `event: ping`.

title: Archive a thread
summary: Archive an idle child thread (a thread parked on requires_action counts as idle). Emits a cross-posted session.thread_status_terminated, frees the concurrency slot, and returns the thread object. The primary thread answers 400 primary_thread_not_archivable, a running or retrying one 409 thread_running, and repeating the call returns the same row with no second event.

response.name: error
response.description: 400 primary_thread_not_archivable for the primary thread; 409 thread_running while the thread is running or retrying.
